Process and correct material goods issues/receipts in cases of errors or shortages. Verify production order receipts — confirming that reported quantities reconcile with OEE data and that pallet/handling-unit quantities have been booked correctly. Experience with press shop, welding, or robotic welding processes and their documentation (setup/changeover sheets). Experience supporting Layered Process Audits (LPA) or similar structured quality-audit programs. Technical degree in Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field. Key Internal Interfaces Maintenance team (MaintPlan data and preventive-maintenance planning). Tooling/Toolroom (master data for tools, machines, and nástroje). Supply Chain (component pricing, spare-parts consumption data). Commercial (sales pricing). Quality (LPA audits, working instructions, standards). Training function (setup/changeover sheet maintenance). IT/network administration (SD server access control, printer network onboarding). Working Conditions Full-time, on-site position at the Nitra plant. Close collaboration with production, maintenance, quality, and commercial teams; occasional shop-floor presence required to validate data at the source (scanning points, changeover stations).
